page.notes: Page is rotated; the heading and table lines are reproduced from the scan. Entry 9 breaks off at the page edge and its page number is not visible. Several words in the entries are doubtful at this scan resolution, notably "prisцis" in entry 2 (likely "prisci"), "domanio" in entry 9 (likely "dominio") and "ap-" (likely "ap-pendicibus"); these are reproduced as best read.
